claims.text: The FDA atazanavir label lists alfuzosin coadministration as contraindicated because of hypotension risk.
claims.quote: Coadministration of atazanavir with alfuzosin is contraindicated due to risk for hypotension [see Contraindications (4) ].

headline.text: The FDA label lists atazanavir with alfuzosin as contraindicated because of hypotension risk.

reported.text: The label explicitly names both drugs in the hypotension warning.

gaps.text: The packet contains no human study quantifying hypotension risk for this combination.
